SLIPPERY_BRIDGE.pages.CALL_DOWNPOUR.desc:
You [sine]tap[/sine] your cane against the bridge and issue a decree to the insolent weather.
Every falling raindrop [blue]halts in midair[/blue], then rises back into the heavens. The gale falls silent. The clouds retreat.
You straighten your spotless coat and cross the dry bridge at an unhurried pace.
THIS_OR_THAT.pages.SCOLD_AWAY.descriptio:
You refuse the absurd choice and instead deliver a [gold]stern rebuke[/gold] with all the authority of a judge.
Your quiet, indisputable verdict shatters the whispers below. The arms recoil into the pit as though scorched by an inviolable law.
The illusion [jitter][red]scatters in terror[/red][/jitter], leaving a few [gold]coins[/gold] behind as a "fine" for the disturbance.
BRAIN_LEECH.pages.INITIAL.options.VAST_K: Choose 1 of 10 random cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BRAIN_LEECH.pages.VAST_KNOWLEDGE.descrip:
Sensing no malice in the tiny creature, you forgive its impertinence and calmly open your mind.
In an instant, [blue]centuries of evolving law and the fathomless memories of an ancient dragon[/blue] crash into it like a tidal wave, overwhelming its meager capacity.
The brain leech [jitter][purple]quivers, terrified and utterly overfilled[/purple][/jitter]. As though granted a pardon, it tumbles from your head and scurries into a dark corner.
TEA_MASTER.pages.INITIAL.options.HALF_PR: Pay [red]100[/red] Gold. Gain [gold]all three[/gold] cups of tea.
LUMINOUS_CHOIR.pages.ENTRUSTED_SPORES.de:
You press a hand into the soft fungal flesh. Its hungry mycelia reach for your veins, only to recoil before the [blue]authority of an ancient font of life[/blue].
The mournful song becomes a [jitter][purple]trembling plea[/purple][/jitter]. The vast fungal network submits, begging to become spores and travel with you through the spire.
You accept its pale light, but issue one [gold]absolute[/gold] decree: it is [red]forbidden[/red] to parasitize any creature passing through these woods. The lights pulse in silent assent, accepting both grace and restraint.
WELLSPRING.pages.TASTE.description:
You remove a glove and, with [blue]impeccable grace[/blue], cup the emerald water as though sampling a rare vintage.
[sine][gold]Luminous dust[/gold][/sine] dissolves on your tongue. Its strange, mellow sweetness is exquisite.
DROWNING_BEACON.pages.INITIAL.options.SA: Lose [red]6[/red] Max HP. Gain a random [gold]Narzissenkreuz Relic[/gold].
DROWNING_BEACON.pages.SALUTE.description:
Rather than climb and disturb the [purple]crumbling ruin[/purple], you stand beside the still water and [gold]solemnly salute[/gold] the lonely beacon.
Within its backward-flowing light, [blue]a familiar shade of azure[/blue] gathers into a [sine][blue]tiny Oceanid[/blue][/sine]. You begin to raise a hand in greeting, but the little figure vanishes like a bubble.
When the ripples fade, a [blue]water-hued gift[/blue] remains.
SUNKEN_TREASURY.pages.LEAVE.description:
The ownerless, ill-gotten wealth holds no appeal. You leave the [jitter][purple]fragile key[/purple][/jitter] where it lies and turn away.
In a spire steeped in greed, holding to your principles feels like a baptism. [gold]Pure justice[/gold] washes the gloom away, leaving the [blue]waters within[/blue] clearer than before.
SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.pages.INITIAL.option: Add a [gold]Converging Tides[/gold] card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.pages.TAKE_AWAY.desc:
You perceive the mortal danger beneath the strange spectacle. To end its [sine][purple]seductive frenzy[/purple][/sine], you extend a hand and reveal your [blue]absolute authority over water[/blue].

The raging vortex collapses at once. Without resistance, it dwindles into a [blue]single droplet[/blue] and slips into the boundless sea within you.
ROOM_FULL_OF_CHEESE.pages.POLITE_TASTE.d:
Treating the scene as an eccentric banquet, you carve a small piece from the "table" and [blue]gracefully[/blue] taste it.

The [sine][gold]rich, clinging texture[/gold][/sine] draws a slight frown. It is far removed from your preference for clean, delicate flavors. Out of courtesy, you leave a few coins on the [b]cheese[/b] table, then calmly depart through the milk-scented door.
WHISPERING_HOLLOW.pages.GIVE_LIFE.descri:
You see that no malice lies beneath the [red]ghastly exterior[/red]. Reaching out, you breathe a thread of vitality from an [blue]ancient font of life[/blue] into its pallid trunk.
The [red]skeletal deadwood[/red] creaks as it unfurls. In gratitude for its renewal, the tree [jitter][purple]shakes its boughs with delight[/purple][/jitter] and drops a strange branch into your palm.
UNREST_SITE.pages.RESCUE_HOSTAGE.descrip:
You see through the disguise of the [purple]malicious grove[/purple]. A flock of strange, lamenting bird spirits is [red]imprisoned[/red] inside its oily trunks.
At a sweep of your cane, [blue]clear water[/blue] douses the flames and shatters their unseen cages. You pass sentence upon the rapacious trees, [gold]sealing them to the earth by their roots[/gold] for [red]20 years of confinement[/red] under Fontaine law.
The freed spirits [sine]circle overhead[/sine], offer their [green]silent gratitude[/green], and vanish into the sky.
One alone remains. It glides through the air and slips directly into your body.
AROMA_OF_CHAOS.pages.WASH_AWAY_CHAOS.des:
You frown at the [sine][purple]chaotic malice gnawing at your reason[/purple][/sine].
At your command, a [blue]pristine mist[/blue] floods the clearing. Cold spring water scours every surface, stripping away the [red]mingled scents of corruption and delusion[/red].
The warped world settles. You breathe the purified air and feel [gold]utterly refreshed[/gold], your thoughts clearer than ever.
TRASH_HEAP.pages.THROW_AWAY_TRASH.descri:
You step neatly around the [jitter][purple]writhing filth[/purple][/jitter], uninterested in whatever may lurk within. Instead, you open your pack and empty the worthless odds and ends gathered along the way.
The heap gives a muffled groan and [red]greedily[/red] swallows the scraps. Brushing imaginary dust from your gloves, you find both your pack and your thoughts a little [gold]lighter[/gold].
SUNKEN_STATUE.pages.REPAIR.description:
You raise your cane. As though obeying an [gold][b]irrefutable decree[/b][/gold], the pond water parts to reveal the statue's ruined base.
You step forward and breathe a trace of life into the [blue]cold, weather-beaten shell[/blue]. With a low hum, the statue begins to tremble.
In silent respect and gratitude, a [purple]fragment of stone imbued with strange power[/purple] slips from the statue and settles into your hand.
SYMBIOTE.pages.PURIFY.description:
Ignoring the [jitter][purple]dark whispers[/purple][/jitter], you raise your cane and pronounce a [gold]judgment of purification[/gold].
A blade of immaculate spring water tears through the black mass. Before such [blue]absolute cleansing[/blue], the [red]ancient evil[/red] has no time even to scream. Its life is stripped away, and it crumbles into harmless ash amid the spray.
POTION_COURIER.pages.BURY.description:
Sorrow passes across your face. As if answering your grief, the spire's vaulted ceiling defies reason and releases a [sine][blue]soft drizzle[/blue][/sine].
You solemnly take one Potion, intending to fulfill the courier's final duty. Then gentle currents turn the earth, laying the [red]unfortunate dead[/red] and their remaining possessions to rest.
In the rain, [gold]a translucent light[/gold] rises from the grave. The [green]soul, freed from its suffering[/green], bows deeply to the god of life who granted it peace.
RANWID_THE_ELDER.pages.INITIAL.options.S: Lose [red]100[/red] Gold and [red]4[/red] Max HP. Gain [blue]3[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold].
RANWID_THE_ELDER.pages.SHOW_CARE.descrip:
As one who has also traveled the long river of time, you recognize the old man's hardship, and [purple]compassion[/purple] stirs within you.
Without ceremony, you share a little [green]vitality[/green] and [gold]wealth[/gold]. In return, you accept his battered trinkets as one party to a fair exchange.
Feeling [green]life kindle anew[/green] within him, Ranwid seems to glimpse your true nature. He thanks you again and again, [jitter]trembling[/jitter]. As his faltering but renewed figure recedes, your resolve to cleanse the spire of its endless sins grows [gold][b]unshakable[/b][/gold].
STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.pages.TAKE_STONE.descr:
You study the [sine][purple]unnatural, lifeless mass[/purple][/sine] and conclude that its very existence conceals an [red]unknown threat[/red].
A distant draconic cry sounds. Before the authority of water, the boulder called [blue]"Eternal"[/blue] collapses into dust. From the [jitter]rising cloud[/jitter], you retrieve one fragment and preserve it as evidence of the judgment.
STONE_OF_ALL_TIME.pages.LEAVE.descriptio:
You feel no attachment to the [purple]desolate courtyard[/purple], nor any desire to disturb its long-standing balance.

You leave the solitary boulder among the ruins to continue its [blue]long, unending silence[/blue].
SPIRIT_GRAFTER.pages.IMPRISON.descriptio:
You tap your cane, and [sine][blue]clear water[/blue][/sine] becomes an unseen prison around the rampaging soul. It hangs helpless in the air, [jitter][purple]quaking beneath your authority[/purple][/jitter].
In accordance with the law, you sentence it to [red]confinement[/red] at your side under strict supervision. For now, the [gold]Supreme Judge[/gold] will serve as this unusual prisoner's jailer.
INFESTED_AUTOMATON.pages.RESHAPE.descrip:
You recognize the wreck: it is the dear friend of that [sine]innocent companion[/sine]. Raising your cane, you unleash the [blue][b]pure force of life[/b][/blue] through a torrent of sourcewater. The current tears away every [jitter][purple]revolting parasite[/purple][/jitter] and rebuilds the ruined chassis.
The cold machine [gold]miraculously[/gold] stirs. Its dim core brightens to a vivid [blue]azure[/blue]. Gears catch with a harsh scrape, and broken symbols dance across its voice module: [sine][blue]"Er... error... li... life-form... th... thank you..."[/blue][/sine]
ROUND_TEA_PARTY.pages.INITIAL.options.DR: Heal to full HP. Take [red]8[/red] damage.
ROUND_TEA_PARTY.pages.DRINK_GOOD_TEA.des:
You calmly explain yourself, then elegantly drain the [jitter][red]murderous brew[/red][/jitter] before the assembled guests.
To you, the [green]lethal poison[/green] merely worsens an already disappointing flavor. The scheming knights and warlords stare in [purple]horror[/purple] as you remain unharmed and even find time to critique the tea.
They immediately adopt their most deferential manners and offer you [gold]the finest hospitality[/gold] until the strange gathering reaches its hasty end.
ROUND_TEA_PARTY.pages.ACCUSE_MURDER.desc:
Your keen senses detect the [red]taint[/red] in the cup at once. In a voice that permits no dispute, you expose the [jitter][purple]conspiracy[/purple][/jitter] behind the false tea party.
Before the panicked guests can draw their weapons, [blue][b]vast, crushing currents[/b][/blue] rise like chains and subdue every knight and warlord in the hall. In the name of the [b]Supreme Judge[/b], you pronounce judgment on the attempted murder and confiscate the [gold]gleaming crown[/gold] as their fine for defying the law.
TRIAL.pages.NEUVILLETTE_REJECT.descripti:
A [red]feverish obsession[/red] with climbing the spire suddenly clouds your mind. You want only to leave, unwilling to waste another second.
When you turn away, the [b]Chief Arbiter[/b] recoils in alarm. He [purple]stumbles[/purple] from his seat and all but [blue]begs[/blue] you to remain and assume the office of Supreme Judge.
The many defendants wait in bewilderment. If you leave, they will never receive a [gold][b]just and impartial verdict[/b][/gold]. A voice within demands an answer: if you yield to this [jitter][red]absurd fixation[/red][/jitter] and permit injustice, [b]will you still be yourself?[/b]
TRIAL.pages.NEUVILLETTE_REJECT.options.F: Accept the office of Supreme Judge.
NEUVILLETTE_EVENT_FOUR_QUADRANTS_LAND.pa:
In a haze, you enter a chamber wholly unlike the rest of the spire.

A colossal machine dominates its center. Its four faces are engraved [blue]"Memory"[/blue], [blue]"Wish"[/blue], [blue]"Soul"[/blue], and [blue]"Persona"[/blue].

The chamber has clearly suffered [jitter][red]catastrophic damage[/red][/jitter]. The first three faces lie shattered and empty. Only [blue]"Persona"[/blue] remains intact, and within it floats a [sine][purple]gem-like substance coursing with strange colors[/purple][/sine].

You reach out and close your hand around the strange gem called "Persona."

To your surprise, it has no weight at all. The instant you touch it, a [jitter][purple]powerful sense of unreality[/purple][/jitter] engulfs you.

Somewhere in the depths of your mind, you seem to sense [blue]{Sense1}[/blue], [blue]{Sense2}[/blue], and [blue]{Sense3}[/blue]...
NEUVILLETTE_EVENT_FOUR_QUADRANTS_LAND.se: an afterimage of time flowing backward
the pride of an armored emperor
the slick flow of ink spirits
the lingering echo of silver bells
the peaceful sleep of a clan mother
NEUVILLETTE_EVENT_FOUR_QUADRANTS_LAND.pa:
You sense [red]danger[/red] hidden within the strange machine. Abandoning your inspection, you turn and leave.

The surrounding visions recede like a tide, and the spire's familiar cold oppression closes around you. When your senses clear, only mottled stone walls remain. The chamber has vanished without a trace, as though everything you saw were merely [sine][purple]a fevered dream[/purple][/sine].
